description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with pure virtual methods for handling various OCI container events, including start, stop, failure, and state change events. It uses JSON objects for event data and is part of the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class for handling OCI container lifecycle events, requiring implementation of methods for container start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStartedEvent
methods.description: Handler for OCI container start event, takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStoppedEvent
methods.description: Handler for OCI container stop event, takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerFailureEvent
methods.description: Handler for OCI container failure event, takes container name and JSON data.

methods.name: onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handler for OCI container state change event, takes container name and JSON data.
